new_recommendations.name: Erika James
new_recommendations.author: Amy Cohn Rieselman
new_recommendations.quote: I love Erika’s Saturday @9 Saha Flow. It’s different every time as far as what we stretch, then her flow is almost always the same going through the warriors, and other asanas to build leg strength. She plays bowls during Savasana. I always feel invigorated and happy after!
new_recommendations.note: Amy described the class she attended in November 2026. Confirm current days, times, and teachers on Saha’s live schedule.

new_recommendations.name: Claudine Beeson
new_recommendations.author: Amy Cohn Rieselman
new_recommendations.quote: Claudine is so talented and masterful as a yoga teacher. Expect fun, challenge, and something new every class. People seek her out. I feel blessed to be her student!
